body:
While a discussion on a task is waiting for the human's reply, the task is marked **Needs attention**, the same way as when an agent asks a question. The mark goes away once the human replies or the discussion ends.

---
For the agent: today a waiting discussion only gives its notice (the pop-up) the attention border and plays the attention sound (`solace_board.waiting_discussion_notice`). The task's own `attention` field, which the card and task view show, is never set for it. The flag is set and held by `board::task_model` (`flag`, `hold`, `message`, `act`), and a discussion waits in `board::runs.wait_discussion`. The Knowledgebase text that lists when a task needs attention (`knowledgebase.sections` in solace-cli/frontend) should name this case too.
title: board: Needs attention while a discussion waits
